name: hotel-agent
description: Hotel booking platform: Express + MongoDB API, Next.js admin dashboard, public guest site and an AI voice receptionist

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix admin install && npm --prefix site install && node scripts/init-env.mjs
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,admin,site -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev" "npm --prefix site run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix admin run build && npm --prefix site run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,admin,site -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix admin start" "npm --prefix site start"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix admin run lint && npm --prefix site run lint
